description: Get an interview participant including their full transcript from the interview run. Use this for verbatim evidence behind a report finding.

participant_id.description: Participant UUID, from the participants in get_interview or from add_interview_participant.

name: get_interview_participant

actor.description: The actor this participant ran as, when source is actor.

behaviour.description: Behavioural sliders (scepticism, technical_literacy, frustration), or null.

status.description: Participant run status: pending, running, completed, failed or cancelled.

transcript.description: The run transcript: the conversation turns and actions, in order.

title: Get interview participant
